implementation_summary.description: Add file locking mechanism to prevent concurrent write conflicts in TodoStorage
changes: Added `use_lock` parameter to TodoStorage.__init__() with default False for backward compatibility
Added `lock_timeout` parameter for controlling lock acquisition timeout (default 30s)
Added `transaction()` context manager for atomic load-modify-save cycles
Integrated filelock library for cross-platform file locking
Added comprehensive test suite with 13 tests covering lock parameters, concurrency, timeout, and backward compatibility

risks.description: File locking behavior may differ across platforms (Windows vs Unix)
risks.mitigation: Using filelock library which abstracts platform differences

risks.description: Lock files (.lock) may be left behind if process crashes
risks.mitigation: Lock files are cleaned up automatically by filelock on subsequent accesses

limitations: Individual load() and save() operations are not atomic - users must use transaction() for full safety
Lock is per-storage-instance; different code paths using different storage instances may still conflict if pointing to same file
